claims.statement: Verify the actual positive self-adjoint Krein realization, full eigenbasis/member estimates for all indices and all 0<=s<7/2, exact Hc4 domain and equivalent norms, and spectral-cutoff density Hc4 in Hc^s. Check no polynomial-density argument is circular.

Verify sections4 and8: the quadratic K-functional minimizer and infinite summation, interpolation of the two fixed multiplier maps, both local norm directions including t=7/2, trace continuity and highest-nonzero complex trace exclusion by the logarithmic Fourier sequence. Cover equality s=1/2,3/2,5/2; a statement that separate traces are discontinuous is not enough.

Verify all-degree high-vanishing H4 core, exact cutoff bounds and fourth-derivative local norm, polynomial approximation, full boundary residual matrix and bounded corrections, all-degree tail elimination, and compression of every continuous annihilator. Distinguish high-tail individual members from compatible combinations in Hc4.

Verify the closure identity, complex codimension, density iff essential indices are retained, all critical index cases, and p6 deletion/non-Schauder/non-Riesz corollary under every nonzero termwise scaling and enumeration. Check the exact proposed card matches the proof and scope exclusions; this review does not approve arbitrary infinite deletions or complete Lean formalization.
